summary: Suzi showcases her teams for clearing Stage 2 Challenge Difficulty across all three equipment dungeons (Grave of Curse, Grave of Rot, and Grave of Venom) in Season 9. She demonstrates full-send damage setups, gear sets, and familiar choices used to beat the bosses. Key takeaways include using Vinyara with high Accuracy to strip buffs in Grave of Curse, utilizing Infernal Hellfire Retainer or Eurion for survival against Deadly Harpy in Grave of Venom, and taking advantage of Dauntless teams for rapid clears.

heroes.name: Vinyara
heroes.verdict: Dispel support for Grave of Curse
heroes.note: Needs high Accuracy (260+) to consistently strip boss buffs in Challenge Mode.

heroes.name: Selva
heroes.verdict: Tank option for Grave of Curse and Grave of Rot
heroes.note: Geared with high HP and Defense to sustain boss damage in Dauntless lineups.

heroes.name: Guinavivre
heroes.verdict: Core Lightning DPS for Dauntless teams
heroes.note: Built in Blazeland Followers (Undying Faith) set for high single-target and multi-hit damage.

heroes.name: Nastjenka
heroes.verdict: Core Lightning DPS for Dauntless teams
heroes.note: Built with high Crit Rate and Attack to burst down equipment dungeon bosses quickly.

heroes.name: Kurvida
heroes.verdict: Lightning DPS / support for Dauntless teams
heroes.note: Equips Witch's Remains artifact to apply debuffs, requiring high Accuracy to bypass boss resistance.

heroes.name: Maashtur
heroes.note: Provides shields and defense buffs in Grave of Rot to help the team survive.

heroes.name: Rena
heroes.verdict: Frontline Radiance tank for Grave of Venom
heroes.note: Positioned in the front spot to absorb heavy single-target hits from Deadly Harpy.

heroes.name: Solmo
heroes.verdict: Radiance support for Grave of Venom
heroes.note: Placed directly behind the main tank so his passive grants shields and stat buffs to the unit in front.

heroes.name: Lincos
heroes.verdict: Radiance buffer / support for Grave of Venom
heroes.note: Built with Golden Antlers to assist the Radiance team in sustaining and buffing damage.

heroes.name: Talethia
heroes.verdict: Main Radiance DPS for Grave of Venom
heroes.note: Equipped in Blazeland Followers set to deal heavy damage and clear wisps and boss.

heroes.name: Diantha
heroes.verdict: Radiance sub-DPS / support for Grave of Venom
heroes.note: Equipped in Puppeteer's Light set and Witch's Remains to boost team energy and deal damage.

heroes.name: Eurion
heroes.verdict: Recommended tank alternative for Grave of Venom
heroes.note: His passive invincibility upon taking fatal damage buys extra time for DPS heroes to finish the boss.

teams.note: Uses Deluxe Mimic familiar for recharge speed penalty on the boss. Vinyara should be built with high Accuracy to dispel boss buffs.
Full-send Dauntless burst team. Debuff removal or immunity is recommended if struggling with Toxin stacks.
Radiance team using Infernal Hellfire Retainer familiar for its revive skill to buy time for Talethia to finish the boss.

tips: Build high Accuracy (260+) on debuffers like Vinyara and Kurvida to bypass high boss resistance in Challenge Stage 2.
In Grave of Venom, position Solmo directly behind your main front tank so his passive grants extra shields and stats to that tank.
Use the Infernal Hellfire Retainer familiar in Grave of Venom for its revive capability, or substitute Eurion as tank for his death prevention passive to buy time for your DPS.
Complete Challenge Stage 2 in all three equipment dungeons to claim Trial of Courage rewards in the Season Assessment tab.
